question: In February 2022, which former Indian footballer passed away at the age of 71?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surajit Sengupta.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Surajit Sengupta was a former Indian footballer who played as a defender for the Indian national team and various clubs in India. **
 
• He was known for his strong tackles and aerial abilities.
 
• **He started his career with Mohun Bagan and later played for East Bengal, Mohammedan Sporting, and Bengal Nagpur Railway. **
 
• He also represented India in the 1978 Asian Games and the 1984 AFC Asian Cup.
 
• After retiring from playing, Sengupta went on to become a coach and managed various clubs in India, including Mohammedan Sporting, East Bengal, and Mohun Bagan.
 
• He passed away on 8th February 2022 at the age of 71 due to age-related ailments. 
 
• **His demise was mourned by the Indian football fraternity, with many players and coaches paying tribute to him on social media.**
